notes.title: Updated Announcement on August 10, 2024
notes.content:
I'm very sorry, because I've been busy recording the Crimson Moon Immortal recently and have some free time. I was planning to conduct internal testing and fix the bug before uploading, but it was leaked by the group's Holy Mother. Oh, it was my mistake, which also caused me to not completely fix the bug and have to upload it.
After all, this is updated for paid supporters, not for free.
I'm sorry for this update, but I will accept any bug submissions within the next five days. And even if updated.
This update mainly includes:
1. Cover
2. UI (User Interface)
3. The high priest added nun's clothing and nun's clothing storyline
4. Brave has added some sweet CG
5. Modified some bugs
Finally, I wish the Virgin Mary who leaked the game, with a family full of descendants, the more the better, all of whom are excellent filial sons.

notes.title: 2021.8.22更新（请保存SAVE文件后重新安装游戏）
notes.content:
1.07更新列表
-修复马亚村后山'魔物公主'不显示的问题
-修复'色欲之阿斯莫德'无法获取的问题
-移除'天神分身'的眩晕效果
-下调'天神'伤害12.5%
-新增'真相线'战斗提示并添加重复挑战
-修正雪原武器店'珍珠戒指'的打造
-修正'海盗基地'和'人鱼地'随机事件加恶堕的问题
-移除海盗基地'订婚戒指'获取
-移除了大地图挡路的山
-修复'马亚村后山'猎人处触发条件
-修复'钓鱼事件'鱼杆断了不扣除的问题
-移除治疗技能速度补正
-技能商店新增'黑暗系'魔法
-怪物出手速度优化
-下调'毁灭残影'双抗22%，生命值46%
-下调'魔物公主'生命值34%
-下调'变异大章鱼生命值32%
-修复'一等奖'抽空的问题
-修复'消失的线索'奖励重复领取的问题
-修复神秘岛1贴图缺失问题
-多处细节优化
